name: Automexa
summary: Clean white AI-automation consultancy page with a hot coral-orange accent, a live workflow card in a glowing gradient frame, and two-tone headlines.

fonts.pairing: Geist 600 with tight -3.5% tracking for headings, Inter 400 for body, Inter 600 uppercase with wide tracking for orange eyebrows

signature: hero workflow card (four pipeline steps, last one in a coral gradient, plus an activity log) wrapped in a soft peach-to-pink glowing border
every section title split in two tones: black words then the key word in coral
dark pill buttons carrying a small coral gradient icon disc at the right end
imagery: abstract 3D orange and red paper-curl and fluid renders for case studies; otherwise icons and UI cards
layout_grid: 1200 canvas, 24px gutters (1152 content), ~110px section padding, alternating white and #f6f5f3 bands, 3-4 column card grids, 18-28px radii
